title: Wire the document gate
description:
Wire check-docs.mjs as described in the skills' documents.md: deterministic export from real docs and tasks, product/feature/acceptance/close phases, evidence level 'records' (no protected CI yet), exemptions for work in flight, capability catalogue seeded from the template. Deferred from the setup task because no specification exists yet; until wired, documents are checked by reading.

## Done when
check-docs runs from the local hooks on real documents, each phase rejects its planted violation, and the integration doc no longer says the gate is not installed.

title: Set up shady2k-skills in this repository
description: Install the shady2k-skills workflow: br tracker, project config, tracker adapter, backlog gate and commit-link check wired to local hooks, integration doc and agent pointer; prove every entry point. Agreed profile: personal scope, English artifacts, block strength, tdd, subagents, push to the public origin, review by another model with a disclosed fallback, milestone mvp with a finding budget of 5, document gate as its own task. The repository is public: no personal data or details of other projects; a privacy guard in pre-commit enforces a private pattern list kept outside the repository.
